### MatchPlayerOddsEntry

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | string \| null | Yes | Player ID. Null when the player cannot be uniquely identified |
| `name` | string | Yes | e.g. `Bukayo Saka` |
| `line` | number | No | Over/Under half-line for ladder markets (`player_shots`, `player_shots_on_target`, `player_shots_on_target_outside_box`, `player_headed_shots_on_target`, `player_tackles`, `player_fouls_committed`, `player_to_be_fouled`, `player_passes`, `goalkeeper_saves`: `0.5`, `1.5`, …). Integer "N or more" thresholds from bookmakers that publish them are normalized to `N - 0.5` Over lines. OMITTED for markets with no line concept (goalscorer variants, cards, `player_of_the_match`, …) |
| `market_type` | string — enum: `Over`, `Under` | No | Direction of the quote. OMITTED for markets with no direction concept (goalscorer variants, cards, …). Books price Over almost exclusively today on player props. Values: `Over`, `Under` |
| `odd` | number | Yes | Latest decimal odds quoted by the bookmaker, rounded to 4 decimal places |

**Example:**

```json
{
  "id": "pl_45126714",
  "name": "Bukayo Saka",
  "line": 1.5,
  "market_type": "Over",
  "odd": 1.1818
}
```

### MatchPlayerOddsMarket

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `name` | string — enum: `anytime_goalscorer`, `first_goalscorer`, `last_goalscorer`, `to_score_2_plus`, `to_score_3_plus`, `hattrick`, `first_half_goalscorer`, `second_half_goalscorer`, `to_score_header`, `to_score_outside_box`, `player_shots`, `player_shots_on_target`, `player_shots_on_target_outside_box`, `player_headed_shots_on_target`, `player_assists`, `score_or_assist`, `player_booked`, `player_sent_off`, `first_card`, `player_tackles`, `player_fouls_committed`, `player_to_be_fouled`, `player_passes`, `goalkeeper_saves`, `player_of_the_match` | Yes | Player-prop market name. Values: `anytime_goalscorer`, `first_goalscorer`, `last_goalscorer`, `to_score_2_plus`, `to_score_3_plus`, `hattrick`, `first_half_goalscorer`, `second_half_goalscorer`, `to_score_header`, `to_score_outside_box`, `player_shots`, `player_shots_on_target`, `player_shots_on_target_outside_box`, `player_headed_shots_on_target`, `player_assists`, `score_or_assist`, `player_booked`, `player_sent_off`, `first_card`, `player_tackles`, `player_fouls_committed`, `player_to_be_fouled`, `player_passes`, `goalkeeper_saves`, `player_of_the_match` |
| `players` | [MatchPlayerOddsEntry](#matchplayeroddsentry)[] | Yes | Entries for this market. Sorted by `(line asc nulls last, market_type asc nulls last, odd asc, name asc)`. Ladder markets emit one entry per `(player × line × market_type)` |

**Example:**

```json
{
  "name": "player_shots",
  "players": [
    {
      "id": "pl_45126714",
      "name": "Bukayo Saka",
      "line": 1.5,
      "market_type": "Over",
      "odd": 1.1818
    }
  ]
}
```

### MatchPlayerOddsBookmaker

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `bookmaker` | string | Yes | Bookmaker display name, same convention as match odds |
| `markets` | [MatchPlayerOddsMarket](#matchplayeroddsmarket)[] | Yes | Markets this bookmaker prices. Only markets with at least one price are included |

**Example:**

```json
{
  "bookmaker": "Bet365",
  "markets": [
    {
      "name": "player_shots",
      "players": [
        {
          "id": "pl_45126714",
          "name": "Bukayo Saka",
          "line": 1.5,
          "market_type": "Over",
          "odd": 1.1818
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

### MatchPlayerOddsTeam

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | string | Yes | e.g. `tm_9145` |
| `name` | string | Yes | e.g. `Arsenal` |

**Example:**

```json
{
  "id": "tm_9145",
  "name": "Arsenal"
}
```

### MatchPlayerOdds

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `match_id` | string | Yes | e.g. `mt_200199332` |
| `home_team` | [MatchPlayerOddsTeam](#matchplayeroddsteam) | Yes |  |
| `away_team` | [MatchPlayerOddsTeam](#matchplayeroddsteam) | Yes | e.g. `{"id":"tm_0256","name":"Leeds United"}` |
| `kickoff_at` | string (date-time) \| null | No | ISO-8601 kickoff timestamp; null when not recorded |
| `bookmakers` | [MatchPlayerOddsBookmaker](#matchplayeroddsbookmaker)[] | Yes | One entry per bookmaker with priced player props, Bet365 first. Bookmakers with no player props for the match are omitted; empty when no bookmaker prices any prop |

**Example:**

```json
{
  "match_id": "mt_200199332",
  "home_team": {
    "id": "tm_9145",
    "name": "Arsenal"
  },
  "away_team": {
    "id": "tm_0256",
    "name": "Leeds United"
  },
  "kickoff_at": "2026-10-10T11:30:00.000Z",
  "bookmakers": [
    {
      "bookmaker": "Bet365",
      "markets": [
        {
          "name": "player_shots",
          "players": [
            {
              "id": "pl_45126714",
              "name": "Bukayo Saka",
              "line": 1.5,
              "market_type": "Over",
              "odd": 1.1818
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

### MatchPlayerOddsEntryV1

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | string \| null | Yes | Player ID. Null when the player cannot be uniquely identified |
| `name` | string | Yes | e.g. `Bukayo Saka` |
| `line` | number \| null | Yes | Over/Under line, e.g. `0.5` or `1.5`. Null for markets with no line, such as `first_goalscorer` |
| `market_type` | string — enum: `Over`, `Under` \| null | Yes | Direction of the quote. Null for markets with no line, such as `first_goalscorer`. Values: `Over`, `Under` |
| `odd` | number (float) | Yes | e.g. `1.182` |

**Example:**

```json
{
  "id": "pl_45126714",
  "name": "Bukayo Saka",
  "line": 1.5,
  "market_type": "Over",
  "odd": 1.182
}
```

### MatchPlayerOddsMarketV1

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `name` | string — enum: `anytime_goalscorer`, `first_goalscorer`, `player_shots`, `player_shots_on_target`, `player_assists` | Yes | Player-prop market name. v1 has these 5 markets only. Values: `anytime_goalscorer`, `first_goalscorer`, `player_shots`, `player_shots_on_target`, `player_assists` |
| `players` | [MatchPlayerOddsEntryV1](#matchplayeroddsentryv1)[] | Yes | Entries sorted by line, market_type, odd, then name |

**Example:**

```json
{
  "name": "player_shots",
  "players": [
    {
      "id": "pl_45126714",
      "name": "Bukayo Saka",
      "line": 1.5,
      "market_type": "Over",
      "odd": 1.182
    }
  ]
}
```

### MatchPlayerOddsV1

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `match_id` | string | Yes | e.g. `mt_200199332` |
| `home_team` | [MatchPlayerOddsTeam](#matchplayeroddsteam) | Yes |  |
| `away_team` | [MatchPlayerOddsTeam](#matchplayeroddsteam) | Yes | e.g. `{"id":"tm_0256","name":"Leeds United"}` |
| `kickoff_at` | string (date-time) \| null | No | ISO-8601 kickoff timestamp; null when not recorded |
| `bookmaker` | string | Yes | Single bookmaker; v1 always returns "bet365" |
| `markets` | [MatchPlayerOddsMarketV1](#matchplayeroddsmarketv1)[] | Yes | Markets for the single bookmaker. Empty when the bookmaker has no priced player props for the match |

**Example:**

```json
{
  "match_id": "mt_200199332",
  "home_team": {
    "id": "tm_9145",
    "name": "Arsenal"
  },
  "away_team": {
    "id": "tm_0256",
    "name": "Leeds United"
  },
  "kickoff_at": "2026-10-10T11:30:00.000Z",
  "bookmaker": "bet365",
  "markets": [
    {
      "name": "player_shots",
      "players": [
        {
          "id": "pl_45126714",
          "name": "Bukayo Saka",
          "line": 1.5,
          "market_type": "Over",
          "odd": 1.182
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

### CoverageSeasonStatus

`complete`: every loaded match has been played. `in_progress`: some loaded matches are still to come. `not_loaded`: no matches are loaded for the season. Based on the matches loaded so far. More values may be added later.

Enum: `complete`, `in_progress`, `not_loaded`

### CoverageDataTypeEntry

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `available` | boolean | Yes |  |
| `covered_events` | integer | No | Finished matches that have this data type. Only on `GET /coverage/leagues/{competition_id}` |
| `coverage_pct` | number | No | Share of finished matches that have this data type, as a percentage with one decimal. Only on `GET /coverage/leagues/{competition_id}` |

**Example:**

```json
{
  "available": <boolean>,
  "covered_events": 380,
  "coverage_pct": 100
}
```

### CoverageDataTypes

Keyed by data type name. New keys may be added, so ignore keys you don't recognise.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `fixtures` | [CoverageDataTypeEntry](#coveragedatatypeentry) | No |  |
| `team_stats` | [CoverageDataTypeEntry](#coveragedatatypeentry) | No |  |
| `xg` | [CoverageDataTypeEntry](#coveragedatatypeentry) | No |  |
| `odds` | [CoverageDataTypeEntry](#coveragedatatypeentry) | No | Alias of closing_odds, kept for existing clients |
| `opening_odds` | [CoverageDataTypeEntry](#coveragedatatypeentry) | No | Opening prices (first price captured per selection) are stored. These fill the `opening` field on `/football/matches/{match_id}/odds` |
| `closing_odds` | [CoverageDataTypeEntry](#coveragedatatypeentry) | No | Closing prices (last pre-match price before kickoff) are stored. These fill the `last_seen` field on `/football/matches/{match_id}/odds` |
| `lineups` | [CoverageDataTypeEntry](#coveragedatatypeentry) | No |  |
| `player_stats` | [CoverageDataTypeEntry](#coveragedatatypeentry) | No |  |
| `standings` | [CoverageDataTypeEntry](#coveragedatatypeentry) | No |  |
| `<key>` | [CoverageDataTypeEntry](#coveragedatatypeentry) | — | Dynamic key (additionalProperties) |

**Example:**

```json
{
  "fixtures": {
    "available": <boolean>,
    "covered_events": 380,
    "coverage_pct": 100
  },
  "team_stats": {
    "available": <boolean>,
    "covered_events": 380,
    "coverage_pct": 100
  },
  "xg": {
    "available": <boolean>,
    "covered_events": 380,
    "coverage_pct": 100
  },
  "odds": {
    "available": <boolean>,
    "covered_events": 380,
    "coverage_pct": 100
  },
  "opening_odds": {
    "available": <boolean>,
    "covered_events": 380,
    "coverage_pct": 100
  },
  "closing_odds": {
    "available": <boolean>,
    "covered_events": 380,
    "coverage_pct": 100
  },
  "lineups": {
    "available": <boolean>,
    "covered_events": 380,
    "coverage_pct": 100
  },
  "player_stats": {
    "available": <boolean>,
    "covered_events": 380,
    "coverage_pct": 100
  },
  "standings": {
    "available": <boolean>,
    "covered_events": 380,
    "coverage_pct": 100
  },
  "<key>": {
    "available": <boolean>,
    "covered_events": 380,
    "coverage_pct": 100
  }
}
```

### CoverageSeasonRef

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|

| `year` | string \| null | No | e.g. `26/27` |

**Example:**

```json

  "year": "26/27"
}
```

### CoverageLeague

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | string | No | e.g. `comp_3039` |
| `name` | string | No | e.g. `Premier League` |
| `country` | string \| null | No | e.g. `England` |
| `country_code` | string \| null | No | e.g. `GB` |
| `seasons` | object { count, first, last } | No | Seasons with matches loaded. `first` and `last` are not always the oldest and newest season; for the full list use `GET /coverage/leagues/{competition_id}` |
| `data_types` | [CoverageDataTypes](#coveragedatatypes) | No | e.g. `{"fixtures":{"available":true},"team_stats":{"available":true},"xg":{"available":true},"odds":{"available":true},"opening_odds":{"available":true},"closing_odds":{"available":true},"lineups":{"available":true},"player_stats":{"available":true},"standings":{"available":true}}` |
| `latest_season` | object { id, year, status, finished_events, total_events } \| null | No |  |
| `total_finished_events` | integer | No | e.g. `4610` |

**Example:**

```json
{
  "id": "comp_3039",
  "name": "Premier League",
  "country": "England",
  "country_code": "GB",
  "seasons": {
    "count": 13,
    "first": {
      "id": "sn_612289",
      "year": "14/15"
    },
    "last": {
      "id": "sn_8406098",
      "year": "26/27"
    }
  },
  "data_types": {
    "fixtures": {
      "available": true
    },
    "team_stats": {
      "available": true
    },
    "xg": {
      "available": true
    },
    "odds": {
      "available": true
    },
    "opening_odds": {
      "available": true
    },
    "closing_odds": {
      "available": true
    },
    "lineups": {
      "available": true
    },
    "player_stats": {
      "available": true
    },
    "standings": {
      "available": true
    }
  },
  "latest_season": {
    "id": "sn_8406098",
    "year": "26/27",
    "status": <string>,
    "finished_events": 50,
    "total_events": 100
  },
  "total_finished_events": 4610
}
```

### CoverageSeason

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | string | No | e.g. `sn_6125938` |
| `name` | string | No | e.g. `Premier League 25/26` |
| `year` | string \| null | No | e.g. `25/26` |
| `status` | [CoverageSeasonStatus](#coverageseasonstatus) | No |  |
| `events` | object { finished, total } | No |  |
| `data_types` | [CoverageDataTypes](#coveragedatatypes) | No | e.g. `{"fixtures":{"available":true,"covered_events":380},"team_stats":{"available":true,"covered_events":380,"coverage_pct":100},"xg":{"available":true,"covered_events":380,"coverage_pct":100},"odds":{"available":true,"covered_events":380,"coverage_pct":100},"opening_odds":{"available":false,"covered_events":0,"coverage_pct":0},"closing_odds":{"available":true,"covered_events":380,"coverage_pct":100},"lineups":{"available":true,"covered_events":380,"coverage_pct":100},"player_stats":{"available":true,"covered_events":380,"coverage_pct":100},"standings":{"available":true}}` |

**Example:**

```json
{
  "id": "sn_6125938",
  "name": "Premier League 25/26",
  "year": "25/26",
  "status": <string>,
  "events": {
    "finished": 380,
    "total": 380
  },
  "data_types": {
    "fixtures": {
      "available": true,
      "covered_events": 380
    },
    "team_stats": {
      "available": true,
      "covered_events": 380,
      "coverage_pct": 100
    },
    "xg": {
      "available": true,
      "covered_events": 380,
      "coverage_pct": 100
    },
    "odds": {
      "available": true,
      "covered_events": 380,
      "coverage_pct": 100
    },
    "opening_odds": {
      "available": false,
      "covered_events": 0,
      "coverage_pct": 0
    },
    "closing_odds": {
      "available": true,
      "covered_events": 380,
      "coverage_pct": 100
    },
    "lineups": {
      "available": true,
      "covered_events": 380,
      "coverage_pct": 100
    },
    "player_stats": {
      "available": true,
      "covered_events": 380,
      "coverage_pct": 100
    },
    "standings": {
      "available": true
    }
  }
}
```

### CoverageLeagueDetail

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | string | No | e.g. `comp_3039` |
| `name` | string | No | e.g. `Premier League` |
| `country` | string \| null | No | e.g. `England` |
| `country_code` | string \| null | No | e.g. `GB` |
| `total_seasons` | integer | No | Every season we know of for the competition, including ones with no matches loaded |
| `loaded_seasons` | integer | No | Seasons with at least one match loaded. Same as `seasons.count` in the list |
| `total_finished_events` | integer | No | e.g. `4610` |
| `seasons` | [CoverageSeason](#coverageseason)[] | No |  |

**Example:**

```json
{
  "id": "comp_3039",
  "name": "Premier League",
  "country": "England",
  "country_code": "GB",
  "total_seasons": 34,
  "loaded_seasons": 13,
  "total_finished_events": 4610,
  "seasons": [
    {
      "id": "sn_6125938",
      "name": "Premier League 25/26",
      "year": "25/26",
      "status": <string>,
      "events": {
        "finished": 380,
        "total": 380
      },
      "data_types": {
        "fixtures": {
          "available": true,
          "covered_events": 380
        },
        "team_stats": {
          "available": true,
          "covered_events": 380,
          "coverage_pct": 100
        },
        "xg": {
          "available": true,
          "covered_events": 380,
          "coverage_pct": 100
        },
        "odds": {
          "available": true,
          "covered_events": 380,
          "coverage_pct": 100
        },
        "opening_odds": {
          "available": false,
          "covered_events": 0,
          "coverage_pct": 0
        },
        "closing_odds": {
          "available": true,
          "covered_events": 380,
          "coverage_pct": 100
        },
        "lineups": {
          "available": true,
          "covered_events": 380,
          "coverage_pct": 100
        },
        "player_stats": {
          "available": true,
          "covered_events": 380,
          "coverage_pct": 100
        },
        "standings": {
          "available": true
        }
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

### CoverageSummary

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `leagues` | integer | No | e.g. `204` |
| `seasons` | integer | No | e.g. `1107` |
| `finished_events` | integer | No | e.g. `202269` |
| `seasons_by_status` | object { complete, in_progress, not_loaded } | No |  |
| `pct_complete` | number | No | Share of seasons that are `complete`, as a percentage with one decimal |

**Example:**

```json
{
  "leagues": 204,
  "seasons": 1107,
  "finished_events": 202269,
  "seasons_by_status": {
    "complete": 922,
    "in_progress": 152,
    "not_loaded": 33
  },
  "pct_complete": 83.3
}
```

### PaginationMeta

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `page` | integer | No | e.g. `1` |
| `per_page` | integer | No | e.g. `20` |
| `total` | integer | No | e.g. `100` |
| `total_pages` | integer | No | e.g. `5` |

**Example:**

```json
{
  "page": 1,
  "per_page": 20,
  "total": 100,
  "total_pages": 5
}
```

### Error

Every error uses this envelope. `code` is a stable UPPERCASE string
to branch on: `BAD_REQUEST`, `UNKNOWN_PARAMETER`,
`SEASON_COMPETITION_MISMATCH`, `PAGE_OUT_OF_RANGE` (400);
`UNAUTHORIZED` (401); `FORBIDDEN`, `KEY_REVOKED`, `ADDON_REQUIRED`
(403); `NOT_FOUND`, `STATS_NOT_AVAILABLE_AT_SOURCE` (404);
`METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED` (405, every endpoint is `GET`); `CONFLICT`,
`MATCH_IS_LIVE` (409); `RATE_LIMITED`, `USAGE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` (429);
`INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR` (500). `message` explains the problem in
plain English.


| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `error` | object { code, message, status_code } | Yes |  |

**Example:**

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "BAD_REQUEST",
    "message": "season_id is required",
    "status_code": 400
  }
}
```

---

## Error Responses

All errors follow this format:

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "string",
    "message": "string",
    "status_code": 400
  }
}
```

| Status | Code | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| 400 | `BAD_REQUEST` | Invalid or missing parameter value |
| 400 | `UNKNOWN_PARAMETER` | Query parameter the endpoint does not accept; the message suggests the right name |
| 401 | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing, malformed or invalid API key |
| 403 | `FORBIDDEN` / `KEY_REVOKED` | Key inactive, or no active subscription plan |
| 404 | `NOT_FOUND` | Resource not found |
| 429 | `RATE_LIMITED` / `USAGE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` | Per-minute or monthly budget used up; wait `Retry-After` seconds |
